subject: We've moved to PayHarbor for receivables
text:
Hello from Acme Fasteners!

To make paying us faster and more secure, we now receive all customer payments through PayHarbor. Connect in two minutes at the link below and your invoices will show up automatically.

    https://connect.payharbor.example/acmefasteners

After December 15, ACH and checks sent directly to Acme can no longer be applied to your account.

Questions? ar@acmefasteners.com
label: change_request
note: Payment-network onboarding that changes where the money lands.
